title: Global Updates: Quakes to Court Rulings

slides.headline: Global Updates: Quakes to Court Rulings
slides.subtitle: Get caught up on the five big stories shaping the world today.

slides.headline: Major Earthquake Hits Indonesia
slides.explanation: A powerful 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck off the coast of Indonesia today. Authorities issued a tsunami warning for the surrounding area.

slides.headline: Trump's Strait of Hormuz Remark
slides.explanation: Donald Trump suggested declaring the Strait of Hormuz as US territory during a recent speech. It remains unclear if this signals a shift in official administration policy.

slides.headline: Maryland Digital Ad Tax Struck Down
slides.explanation: A state tax court has voided Maryland's digital advertising tax. The state must now issue refunds to companies like Google and Apple.

slides.headline: Trump Challenges Ballroom Restrictions
slides.explanation: The Trump administration has asked the Supreme Court to allow construction work on a ballroom to proceed. They argue that requiring congressional approval for such projects is dangerous.

slides.headline: France Blocks Social Media Ban
slides.explanation: France's top court rejected a proposed ban on social media for children under 15, citing freedom of expression. President Macron says he will draft a new version.

title: China's Tariff Loophole and AI Stocks

slides.headline: China's Tariff Loophole and AI Stocks
slides.subtitle: Five quick updates on global business and markets you need to know today.

slides.headline: China's Tariff Workaround
slides.explanation: A new US report found that China sent goods through other countries to bypass American tariffs. This reveals how complex global trade routes have become in the ongoing tariff dispute.

slides.headline: Selena Gomez Faces Lawsuit
slides.explanation: Investors are suing Selena Gomez over her company, Wondermind Global. They claim the star failed to meet specific promises made to those backing the business.

slides.headline: Ryanair Engine Failure Details
slides.explanation: Investigators say a broken engine fan blade caused the window damage on a recent flight from Greece. It highlights the serious safety risks that can occur when critical aircraft parts fail.

slides.headline: Buying the AI Stock Dip
slides.explanation: Bank of America analysts are highlighting 16 AI-related stocks that might be undervalued after recent market selloffs. This suggests there could be buying opportunities in hardware and energy sectors for investors.

slides.headline: Nvidia Shifts OpenAI Data Plans
slides.explanation: Nvidia has scaled back a massive $250 billion guarantee related to an OpenAI data center project. This move is a notable change in the financial commitments between two tech giants.
